title: PAL’s first Airbus A330 lands at Bohol-Panglao International Airport

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — The Bohol-Panglao International Airport (BPIA) welcomed Philippine Airlines’ (PAL) first Airbus A330 flight to Bohol on Tuesday, Oct. 27, marking a milestone in the province’s growing air connectivity and tourism development. The wide-body aircraft arrived at 6:25 a.m. on flight PR1771 from Manila, carrying 150 passengers. It received a water cannon salute, a traditional aviation welcome for milestone flights. The aircraft later departed for Manila as flight PR1772 with 190 passengers, bringing the total number of travelers served during its first rotation to 340.
